description: Capability for the main window. The frontend uses exactly two things from `@tauri-apps/api`: `invoke` (core:app) and `listen` (core:event). App commands are not ACL-gated in Tauri 2, so nothing else here is needed: no webview, window, path, resources, image, menu, tray or asset-protocol grants. Player headshots and manager avatars arrive as data: URIs through `invoke`, and the file dialog is opened from Rust, so the webview never asks for either.
